escalation_reason: planner stop: dead-lettered root is holding the chain; a human should decide whether replaying it is safe
findings: The chain's root job is dead-lettered after exhausting its three retries, and the descendant behind it is still waiting. The upstream parent completed normally, so the failure is isolated to the root. Because dead_letter is terminal and the resolver only promotes a child whose parents have all completed, nothing will move this chain without intervention.
recommendation: Read the root's error_message to decide whether the failure is transient. If it is, replaying the root with replay_dlq_by_ids un-sticks the whole chain — the replayed root completes and the resolver promotes the held descendants. If it is not, the waiting descendants should be cancelled rather than left pending indefinitely.
